description: Sixteen sample players laid out as a four-by-four grid, stepped by triggers that move the playhead in a chosen direction

params.text: Moves the playhead to the top left pad
Moves the playhead one pad to the right and plays it
Moves the playhead one pad to the left and plays it
Moves the playhead one pad down and plays it
Moves the playhead one pad up and plays it
Moves the playhead one pad in a direction picked at random and plays it
Holds the playhead where it is and plays that pad again
Loads sixteen files picked at random from a directory, one to each pad
Shuffles the samples between the pads
Loads one file and cuts it into sixteen pieces, one to each pad
Turns some of the samples back to front, picked at random
Silences some of the pads, picked at random
Sets the level of the sound leaving the module

inputs.text: A trigger here moves the playhead to the top left pad
A trigger here moves the playhead one pad to the right and plays it
A trigger here moves the playhead one pad to the left and plays it
A trigger here moves the playhead one pad down and plays it
A trigger here moves the playhead one pad up and plays it
A trigger here holds the playhead where it is and plays that pad again
A trigger here moves the playhead one pad in a direction picked at random and plays it
Picks which pad plays by pitch, the lowest pad at C3 and one pad per semitone up from there
A trigger here plays the pad the playhead is on
A trigger here shuffles the samples between the pads
A trigger here turns some of the samples back to front
A trigger here silences some of the pads
A trigger here loads sixteen files picked at random from a directory

notes: a pad with no sample in it is silent; click the empty waveform to open a file dialogue, or drop a WAV file onto it
the wave mark on a pad loads a file into it, the cross clears the sample out of it, and the dice loads one at random
right-clicking a pad's waveform opens a file dialogue for that pad
dragging across a pad's waveform sets the point in the sample that pad starts from
the dice on a pad draws from the directory set in the menu; with none set, a file dialogue opens instead
the playhead moves only when one of the direction buttons is pressed or a trigger arrives at one of the direction inputs; there is no clock input
menu: Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Ignore Gate for V/OCT Out — keeps the pitch output following the sequence even on steps whose gate is off
Select Pattern — sets the path off the edge of the grid: Row Wrap (Stay Row), Row-Major, Column-Major, Snake Rows, Snake Columns, Snake Diagonal Down-Right, Snake Diagonal Up-Right
Enable Fades — fades each sample in and out over the length set by the slider below it
Reset All Start Points — puts every pad back to starting at the beginning of its sample
Mute All Cells — silences every pad
Unmute All Cells — lets every pad sound again
Change Directory… — chooses the directory the random sample loads draw their files from
